retraction.reason: Retracted in M22: the Azorean regional election of 14 October 1984, won again by the Social Democrats under João Bosco Mota Amaral. The atlas keeps the first exercise of an institution and the ballot at which it became a cycle, and retracts the routine repetitions after them; the third Azorean regional election is one. The only link available is the constitutional one the earlier records already carry. Revisit if a consequence is written.
